prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm bronze-brown complexion, early 30s goddess, legendary bust physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her upper body so wide; a mythologically, legendarily enormous bust dominates her entire silhouette, resting heavy and full, far wider than her own shoulders and projecting well forward of the rest of her body, the single defining feature of her frame, every other curve secondary to it; below it a waistline still draws in with a visible inward pull, round hips and soft thighs continue her curves; her head looks small in comparison to her massive bust; the bust is unmistakably, overwhelmingly the dominant feature; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, sleek slicked-back balayage hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a scarf top made from a navy-bordered white triangular school scarf of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey folded around her bust, tied behind her neck and back, with its front corners knotted at the center of her chest under a small gold school pin and the two short ends hanging down, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and an ultra-micro flared cheerleader skirt of ultra-thin matte forest-green modal jersey with a white trim along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones and flaring outward with the hem ending a hand-width below her hip bones, the matching micro briefs of the same fabric peeking beneath the hem. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and a small beauty mark near her lips. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the clean edges of the flared cheerleader skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Polynesian woman with a broad face, full lips and large dark eyes, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a sunlit white-washed courtyard with a pale tiled floor, an arched doorway at normal height, low stone steps and a waist-high wall, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
